name: Activity
description: Everything done to your vault and the app, and by whom: your edits and moves, coding agents working through the CLI or the API, changes on disk. Kept on this machine for two weeks, and each day's recap in the vault for good: what you made and changed, tasks done, things captured. Plus how fast the server and the app are.
forAgents: What the user did on a day (notes changed and what changed, tasks done, captures, logs): `activity.recap` (`vau recap 2026-10-06`), kept in `Recaps/<date>.md`.

keep_days.label: Days to keep
keep_days.description: how long events and timings are kept on this machine

reads.label: Record reads
reads.description: what agents and scripts read is recorded too, not only what they change

recaps.label: Write day recaps
recaps.description: each day's recap goes in the vault (Recaps/<date>.md), with the text you changed quoted, to keep

capture_folders.label: Capture folders
capture_folders.description: folders whose new files are captures, like Transcripts for a transcriber's exports (clips and bookmarks are found without it)

activity.description: what was done to the vault and the app, and by whom, newest first
activity.live: this machine's activity record (not in the vault)

actor.description: only what this kind of actor did

path.description: only events on one file: a vault path, or this for the file the block is in

recap.description: what you did on a day, as a timeline: notes made and changed with the text changed, tasks done or dropped, captures, logs, agents' sessions; filter by kind, step by day, week or month
recap.live: today's made from this machine's activity and file history; earlier days from their recaps (Recaps/<date>.md)

date.description: the day (YYYY-MM-DD); left out: the date of the note it's in (a daily note), else today

days.description: how many days, ending with that one: 7 for a week

recap-stats.description: the last weeks of recaps as a grid of days, darker the more done, and how many of each kind
recap-stats.live: the recaps in the vault, today's made now

activity-summary.description: the last 24 hours (or days) by you, agents and the rest, then who and the files touched most
activity-summary.live: this machine's activity record (not in the vault)

days.description: how many days back: 1 is the last 24 hours by hour, more is by day

perf-server.description: the server's uptime, memory, event loop delay and requests, with per-minute response times
perf-server.live: this server's own timings (not in the vault)

minutes.description: how many minutes back the charts and counts go

perf-routes.description: each API route's count and timings, and the slow requests
perf-routes.live: this server's own timings (not in the vault)

minutes.description: how many minutes back the timings go

perf-app.description: what each app window reports about its own speed
perf-app.live: this server's own timings (not in the vault)
